caveats: One minus completion predicts noncompletion, which differs from unmatched exposure.
Identical frozen decision-time observations and group partitions; no independent new samples.
Models were selected on this validation set; comparison is exploratory, not independent evidence.
Target-specific Brier scores concern different outcomes and cannot rank the underlying tasks.
No final classifier test opened, no policy gate retuned, and no real fill or profitability claim.
interpretation: On identical validation observations, inverse completion probability had unmatched-risk Brier 0.524142 versus direct risk Brier 0.089250. In the combined development data, 915 of 1077 incomplete proposals had matched inventory. This motivates distinct target modelling; it does not establish independent generalization or policy profitability.
next_experiment: Evaluate frozen completion and direct exposure models as paired decision policies on validation only; preregister fresh independent groups for any new policy selection. Develop residual-share severity separately from dollar losses and recovery costs.
title: Completion failure is a poor unmatched-exposure proxy on paired validation observations
